title: Integrating ImGui into OGL.c
summary: Walk through every IMGUI section of the starter OGL.c: headers, WndProc forwarding, IMGUI_initialize / IMGUI_display / IMGUI_uninitialize, the run.bat build, and common pitfalls.

quiz.q: Why does run.bat pass /TP when compiling OGL.c?
options: To compile the .c file as C++, because imgui.h is C++
quiz.explain: /TP treats every source file as C++. ImGui uses namespaces, references and default arguments.
The OpenGL2 backend creates and deletes GL textures (the font atlas), so ImGui's lifetime must sit inside the GL context's lifetime.

quiz.q: What is the correct order inside IMGUI_display()?
options: ImGui_ImplOpenGL2_NewFrame, ImGui_ImplWin32_NewFrame, ImGui::NewFrame, UI, ImGui::Render, RenderDrawData
quiz.explain: Backends first, then the core NewFrame, your widgets, Render to build draw data, and finally the renderer backend draws it. All of this happens before SwapBuffers.

quiz.q: The UI is drawn but clicks do nothing. What is the most likely cause?
quiz.explain: Without the WndProc forwarding ImGui never sees mouse or keyboard messages.
